title: T-pillar design on the Gate of the Sun

tellings.quote: That's from the back of the sunate in tiwanaku bivia and it's the same concept of the three doorways

plain: A T-shaped pillar design is carved on the back of the Gate of the Sun, a stone gateway at the ancient site of Tiwanaku in Bolivia. The researcher Matt LaCroix points this out on the podcast without naming a source. He says it shows "the same concept of the three doorways" that he sees at other ancient sites, which would suggest a shared idea linking cultures far apart.
